intro: RRB Railway has Released Official Notification for the Post Of Assistant Loco Pilot ALP CEN . No.01/2026 Recruitment 2026 for 11127 Post. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to Railway RRB ALP Jobs. Online Apply Start On May 15, 2026 & Last Date for Application is June 14, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
importantDates: CBT Exam City : 04 Days Before Exam Date
Age Relaxation Extra as Per Rules.
Important Instruction for the All Candidates Expect the Fee Concession Categories.
Candidates Must be Enter the Your Account Number, Account Holder Name, IFSC Code Under Login Section.
Railway Will be Refunded General/ OBC/ EWS Candidates Rs. 400 & SC / ST Candidates Rs. 250/-
After the Appear the First Stage CBT Examination Your Exceed Amount Will be Refunded at Your Bank.
Note : If you have Not Appeared in CBT Exam Amount Not be Refunded.
Mode of  Selection on the based of CBT-1, CBT-II, CBAT, DV & Medical Exam.
Age is calculated as on 01 July 2026.
Age Relaxation: As per Railway Rules.
10th Pass + ITI in relevant trade OR 10th + Diploma in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics Engineering
Selection Process: CBT-1 → CBT-2 → CBAT → Document Verification → Medical Test
Central Government Railway Job with Good Salary
Excellent Career Growth in Indian Railways
